0.content: Kuki Shinobu is the Arataki Gang's deputy and its only organised member. She was formerly a shrine maiden, has a stack of certifications, and studied law in Liyue. She handles fines, bail, licenses and business, and returns the toys and snacks Itto "wins" off children. Itto insists nobody questions his leadership except Shinobu, and he lets it slide because she gets him out of every mess. He also does not want to see an angry Shinobu. She says his resilience is rare and his character is good for the gang, but it is no excuse to run amok, and she will make him regret any rudeness.

1.content: During the Vision Hunt Decree, the Tenryou Commission's tengu general Kujou Sara defeated Itto and confiscated his Vision. He says the Shogun must have found him a real pain to send her top tengu. He admits the loss freely. What galls him is that she will not accept his street-corner sumo rematch. He plastered bulletin boards in Hanamizaka and Ritou with challenges, and she scrawled exasperated replies. Sara calls him the noisiest oni she has ever met and grants that he was man enough to admit defeat. She refuses to discuss the rematch.

2.content: Granny Oni is an elderly, bespectacled human woman who found the young Itto collapsed in the street after a beating by ruffians. Ignoring his insistence that he was an oni, she offered him porridge, and she raised him from then on. She is called "Granny Oni" only because she took in an oni child. Itto calls her the kindest human who ever lived, and his one real trouble is that people go after her because of him. She thinks the Arataki Gang was never formed at all; to her they are just "Itto and his friends".

3.comment: Arataki Itto: The Crimson Oni and the Blue Oni
3.content: Every oni child knows the fable: a gentle Crimson Oni wanted to live among humans, so his friend the Blue Oni played the villain and let himself be driven off, winning the humans' trust for the Crimson Oni, then left on a journey. Itto loved this story and is proud of his Crimson Oni descent. In his story quest (2.3) he revealed the hidden history: the oni clans made a pact, and the blue oni set conditions on the crimson oni who would live with humans. They must never misuse their strength and must keep their pride. The blue oni were thought to have died out; a tribe survives in seclusion.

4.comment: Arataki Itto: Ushi and Crimson Staff
4.content: Ushi is a young Akaushi bull with golden horns, a little oni-faced roof on his back, and a tail tipped like a Geo crystal. He is an "auxiliary member" of the Arataki Gang. Itto calls on him in battle (and in game, throws him). Ushi has principles of his own and refuses anything unlawful; he helps Shinobu and chose to stay at Itto's side when she suggested he find his own path. In the Chasm, Ushi warned Itto of an argument and "looked for exits". Crimson Staff is Itto's prized Onikabuto, trained for years.

5.comment: Arataki Itto: The Vision Hunt Decree and Itto's Vision
5.content: Itto found his Geo Vision under his hip one morning after years in Hanamizaka. That day he showed it, and the dent it left in his back, to everyone. A few days later he claimed he had not been surprised at all, and that a person's worth is not decided by a Vision. Under the Vision Hunt Decree Kujou Sara took it, and it was set into the Statue of the Omnipresent God at the very bottom. That still infuriates him: the more powerful the Vision, the higher it should go. After the Decree was abolished he got it back and announced himself "Arataki 'A Vision Returned' Itto". He has forgiven the Shogun, "as long as she's learned her lesson".
